name: 34974-specdecode-qwen38b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one engine, one GPU, with the draft model co-resident on the same card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, bounded at 2560 requests / 1800 s safety; 5% warmup fires and drops the first 128 requests by completion (~2432 scored), 5% cooldown is declared but inert on a request bound.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets; prompt exactly 256 tokens and output exactly 512, with `ignore_eos` forced by the fixed max_tokens; `request_format: plain` posts raw text with no chat template; every request sampled at temperature 0.6.
purpose: A long-form text completion service on an 8B model with a draft model, serving 64 concurrent streams on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 59c62332978fcce318784df499713764f14c7bc1 (v0.16.0rc1-351-g59c6233297).
# speculative-config must stay on ONE line: written as an indented block mapping the key is
# dropped and the engine starts without speculation at rc=0.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
speculative-config: {"method": "draft_model", "model": "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-seqs: 128
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-prefix-caching: false
